answer: Temporal Presence Ledger. Each identity must publish a signed beacon at unpredictable intervals averaging 90 seconds; the schedule is derived from a public randomness source, so missed or clustered check-ins are flagged. An orchard of independent validators co-signs each beacon with latency proofs, and a comet-like audit trail of prior check-ins makes retroactive fabrication detectable. New identities start unverified and gain standing only after 30 days of continuous presence.
